content.user_title: Build and Configure AI Agents in Cargo
content.value_statement: Configuring agents requires coordinating prompts, models, knowledge, tools, and releases. This skill guides Cargo configuration through documented CLI workflows and examples.
actual_capabilities: Create, inspect, rename, organize, and remove Cargo agents using documented CLI commands.
Discover agent templates and adapt their prompts, model settings, and temperature.
Configure draft releases and deploy versioned agent configurations.
Attach existing knowledge files or libraries through release resources for retrieval.
Publish curated MCP servers, connect external MCP clients, and disable selected tools.
Inspect, update, and remove memories within agent, user, or workspace scopes.
limitations: Requires the external Cargo CLI, authentication, a workspace, and sufficient permissions.
Knowledge uploads and library management belong to cargo-content; agent execution belongs to cargo-orchestration.
Structured output and heartbeat settings require direct API calls because documented CLI flags are unavailable.
Model availability and command support depend on your Cargo environment and CLI version.

use_cases.title: Configure a Lead Research Agent
use_cases.description: Adapt a research template, select model settings, and prepare an agent release for prospect research.

use_cases.title: Attach an Existing Knowledge Library
use_cases.description: Inspect an agent draft and attach approved knowledge resources before deploying the updated configuration.

use_cases.title: Expose Selected Workspace Tools
use_cases.description: Publish a curated MCP server with selected actions and read-only model resources for a coding assistant.

prompt_templates.title: Inspect Available Agents
prompt_templates.prompt: Confirm my active Cargo workspace, then list agents and templates. Summarize available configurations without changing anything.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare an Agent Draft
prompt_templates.prompt: Find a company classification template and prepare a new agent draft. Use low temperature and show the configuration before deployment.

prompt_templates.title: Attach Approved Knowledge
prompt_templates.prompt: Attach my approved existing library to the specified agent draft. Preserve existing resources and tools, summarize changes, and request approval before deployment.

prompt_templates.title: Publish a Curated MCP Server
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a curated Cargo MCP server for these approved tools and model columns. Keep data read-only and require approval before publishing.

output_examples.input: What should I inspect before configuring a company scoring agent?
output: Confirm the active workspace and locate the target agent.
Inspect classification templates and the current draft release.
Review the prompt, model, temperature, actions, and resources before making changes.

output_examples.input: Why does my agent ignore its knowledge library?
output: An uploaded library is not automatically available to an agent.
Check whether the library is included in the draft release resources.
Confirm that the deployed release includes the intended knowledge configuration.

output_examples.input: How should I expose selected CRM data through MCP?
output: Use a curated workspace MCP server rather than assuming the platform server has the same scope.
Select approved model columns and filters, and keep resources read-only.
Review the complete action and resource arrays before publishing or replacing configuration.

best_practices: Confirm the workspace and target UUIDs before writes, deletions, or deployments.
Read current configuration and preserve complete arrays when updates replace actions, resources, or capabilities.
Use trusted MCP endpoints, minimal tool access, and read-only data resources unless writes are explicitly required.
anti_patterns: Deploying a draft without reviewing its prompt, model, resources, and tools.
Assuming knowledge uploads automatically attach resources to an agent.
Treating published workspace MCP servers and consumed external MCP clients as interchangeable.

faq.question: Can I use this skill with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: The skill declares support for all three. CLI workflows require an environment that can run Cargo commands.

faq.question: What do I need before using the skill?
faq.answer: Install the Cargo CLI, authenticate, and confirm your workspace. Your account must have permissions for the requested operations.

faq.question: Does this skill upload knowledge files?
faq.answer: Its primary scope is attaching existing knowledge to agents. Use cargo-content for uploads and library management.

faq.question: Does this skill run agents or send messages?
faq.answer: Its primary scope is agent configuration and deployment. Use cargo-orchestration for messages, agent runs, and polling.

faq.question: How do MCP servers and MCP clients differ?
faq.answer: Workspace MCP servers expose selected Cargo tools and data. MCP clients connect Cargo agents to external or connector-backed tool servers.

faq.question: Can I set structured output or heartbeat through CLI flags?
faq.answer: The documented release commands do not expose those flags. The skill describes direct API payloads for these settings.
